text: I bet a hundred dollars you didn't know there are some countries that look
completely different but are almost exactly the same size. Let's start with
number five, Nepal and Bangladesh. They are only 22 kilometers apart but one
touches the sky with Mount Everest while the other touches the ocean with
its rivers. Number four is Guinea and the United Kingdom. You won't believe it.
Once the biggest empire in the world, it now has an area as small as Guinea.
Number three is chili and Zambia.
If you pull Zambia like chewing gum, then you would get another chili of the same size.
Number two is Italy and the Philippines.
One looks like a boot, while the other looks like a sitting man.
but put them together and they form a complete human body.
And number one is Malaysia and Vietnam.
Both are in Southeast Asia, have long coastlines,
and are almost the same size.
I think they were made for each other.
Want to go double or nothing?
